title: Finite split and matching data on the explicit attachment
statement: Given a truncated finite split etale hypercover U through n [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover], boundary data Q [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage], and a surjective map b:V to Q.M, where V has the required finite qcqs coproduct presentation, the explicitly constructed attached simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-attachment-construction] admits finite split hypercover data through n+1 whose restriction is exactly U. This statement has no refinement target or refinement natural transformation.

source.place: 0DAV, splitting cofans of the new degree; 01GJ, matching map and covering condition.

proof.text: Use U.N and U.inclusion below the top degree, and V with coprod.inl at the top degree. In a lower degree no epi can have top target, so remove impossible labels and reuse U.splitting. In the top degree an epi endomorphism is the identity. Separate this label from the proper epi labels: the resulting cofan is exactly the canonical binary and indexed coproduct cofan, by attachmentMap_epi and attachEpi_fac.

Retain the old matching objects, projections and maps. Use Q.M and its projections for the top matching object, transporting its universal property along attachedSimplicial_restrict. The attachFace_naturality equation supplies the cone of top operators. The unique map from that cone is the top matching map. Universal uniqueness identifies its composite with coprod.inl with b; surjectivity of b then proves it is surjective.

Use the given finite presentation for V and the old finite presentations in all lower degrees. All old fields are retained literally; the explicit restriction theorem, uniqueness of colimit witnesses, and proof irrelevance for proposition-valued fields give equality of the restricted structure with U.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_attached_split_structure
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {n : ℕ} (U : TruncatedFiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X n)
    (V : X.Etale) (Q : ReplacementBoundary U) (b : V ⟶ Q.M)
    (hc : Surjective b.left)
    (hf : ∃ (k : ℕ) (W : Fin k → X.Etale) (ι : ∀ i, W i ⟶ V),
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk V ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, CompactSpace (W i).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (W i).left ∧
          LocallyOfFinitePresentation (W i).hom ∧ QuasiCompact (W i).hom ∧
            QuasiSeparated (W i).hom) :
    ∃ U' : TruncatedFiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X (n + 1),
      U'.simplicial = attachedSimplicial U V Q b ∧
        U'.restrict n (Nat.le_succ n) = U
